rows.feature: box option corner equal to half the shortest side, shortest side on X or Y (box(12,20,30,{corner:6}), box(10,20,30,{corner:5}), box(40,6,6,{corner:3}))
rows.evidence: WRONG SOLID, NO SENTENCE. Ran contract/measure-primitives.mjs --prefix=r2-corner-half and --only=r2-box-12-20-30-c6,r2-box-10-20-30-c5,r2-box-5-20-30-c2.5,r2-capsule-40-6-6,r2-capsule-6-40-6. The script only checks corner is a positive number, so truck is reached and builds a 12-face solid (the status is built, nothing is shown). Truck volume vs closed form (Minkowski stadium, independent of every kernel): box(12,20,30,{corner:6}) 7972.520 vs 5573.309 (43% too big, and larger than the unrounded 12x20x30 box, 7200); box(20,12,30,{corner:6}) 7972.520 (same); box(10,20,30,{corner:5}) 6879.219 vs 4879.793; box(20,10,30,{corner:5}) 6879.219; box(5,20,30,{corner:2.5}) 3725.688 vs 2725.848; box(20,5,30,{corner:2.5}) 3725.688; capsule box(40,6,6,{corner:3}) 1554.220 vs 1074.425, box(6,40,6,{corner:3}) 1554.220. Live OCCT throws on each ("Rounding box box1 (12x20x30) at radius 6 failed -- the radius is too big for this shape's edges.") and brep-rs refuses each ("Rounding box by 6 would not fit its shortest side -- box1 is shown without it."), so the two independent kernels agree the shape cannot be built and truck alone returns a solid. Only the case where the shortest side is uniquely Z is correct (next row); box(6,6,40,{corner:3}) (X and Y tie, Z longest) and box(20,20,20,{corner:10}) are refused by truck. PRE-FLIGHT NEEDED: refuse corner >= half the shortest side (see the near-limit row for the margin); until it exists this is wrong, not supported.
